articles.title: Stablecoin growth has stalled. The payments boom hasn't
articles.snippet: Stablecoin supply has barely grown this year, even as payments using the tokens surge. Circle's latest earnings offer another example of the divergence between dollars outstanding and activity on blockchain networks.

articles.title: These Finland homes get free heat from bitcoin miners (as long as BTC stays above $70,000)
articles.snippet: A Finnish startup has 30 bitcoin mining systems working as central heating, and at today’s prices each one earns slightly more than the electricity it burns.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin flatlines under $76,000 as stock bounce loses steam into the close
articles.snippet: The Nasdaq gained just 1.1%, while the S&P 500 only edged higher, and the DJIA lost more ground.

articles.title: Zcash’s landmark NU7 upgrade goes live, speeding up private payments
articles.snippet: NU7 cuts the target time between blocks to 25 seconds, reduces the work wallets must do to find private payments and sets aside fees for future miners.

articles.title: Bitcoin developer proposes ‘landmines’ to make quantum thieves lose their own BTC
articles.snippet: Anyone trying to move vulnerable bitcoin would have to put up matching collateral, giving prepared owners a chance to take both.
